entries.canonical_name: Super Bock Arena — Pavilhão Rosa Mota
entries.notes: Verified current site: 'The Events Calendar' WordPress plugin list view, 40 raw records live (24 music-tagged via this venue's own first-party category taxonomy), full dated 2026-2027 programme, no pagination needed. Implemented via ingestion/super-bock-arena/. Venue already canonical (ADDRESS_ONLY) from LISBON-PORTO-VENUE-ESTATE-01 — this package added the source only.

Verified current site: a genuine first-party JSON-LD Event array embedded directly on /agenda/, confirmed-UTC startDate/endDate, 10 raw records live. Implemented via ingestion/lav/. NOT previously canonical (LISBON-PORTO-VENUE-ESTATE-01 found the address only via secondary sources and declined to admit it) — this package admitted it as a NEW ADDRESS_ONLY canonical Venue via `npm run onboard:venues`, using this same source's own first-party address evidence (never hand-authored, never re-geocoded — coordinate research stays closed).

Verified current site (homepage + /shows/ page + wp-json root): no dated calendar of individual performances exists anywhere in the server-rendered HTML — only a static 'Quinta à domingo, 21h30-02h30' recurring-hours line. No JSON-LD, no iframe, no third-party ticketing embed, no custom REST endpoint carrying show dates. This matches this same venue's own event-evidence records in LISBON-PORTO-VENUE-ESTATE-01 being honestly flagged low-confidence ('year inferred from retrieval context'). No full calendar date can be safely derived — deferred, per this task's absolute no-invented-dates rule. Remains the strongest unautomated P1 opportunity if a future session finds a dated source (e.g. an Instagram/Facebook feed with genuine dates, or a booking-platform page not reached this session).

Secondary P1 backlog item (source_priority P1 in sources/lisbon.json, monitoring_status READY_FOR_TECHNICAL_PROOF before this package). Verified current site: /en/programme/ lists 26 raw items with a genuine first-party area+category taxonomy; 14 are area=Music/category=Concerts, each with a full DD.MM.YY date and 12-hour time. Implemented via ingestion/galeria-ze-dos-bois/. Venue already canonical (ADDRESS_ONLY) from LISBON-PORTO-VENUE-ESTATE-01.

Secondary P1 backlog item (source_priority P1). Verified current site: /agenda-de-fados-em-lisboa/ publishes a genuine day-by-day performer roster, but every date is a bare weekday NAME ("Sábado", "Domingo", ...) with no calendar date, month, or year anywhere on the page — a real recurring roster, not individually dated events. No safe calendar date derivable — deferred, not implemented.

Secondary P1 backlog item (source_priority P1). Verified current site: /eventos lists 6 raw items with a genuine first-party category ('Concerto', 'Workshop', 'Visitas', or none), full 'D month, YYYY' dates including year, and a per-item venue-name field (its two live 'Concerto'-tagged items are both off-site at Centro Cultural de Belém, not this venue's own building). Genuinely deterministic and implementable (classification B), but only 2 of 6 raw records are currently music-tagged — deliberately NOT implemented this package in favour of the three higher-yield sources actually built, per this task's 'quality over count' rule. The strongest remaining P1 opportunity after Hot Five for a future package: small, clean, real dated evidence, would reuse the exact same category+venue-name pattern already proven for cm-gaia-eventos/teatro-municipal-do-porto.

P2 in sources/lisbon.json (not one of the P1 priorities), assessed anyway as part of this package's secondary-backlog verification pass. Verified current site: /agenda/ lists dated cards ('SEXTA FEIRA / 21 AGO / 23H'), but no year appears anywhere on the page for any entry — deferred, not implemented, per the absolute no-invented-year rule (today being 2026-08-24 makes a 2026 guess tempting but explicitly disallowed).
